'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Norman Lansing DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Norman Lansing]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Here comes the Scum. Norman Lansing / Anastar Reaver, 2014 Worlds Day 2 08/23/14, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Anastar Reaver
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
